:root{--orange:#f26700;--dark:#0d1821;--white:#fff;--muted:#67727c}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#17212a;background:#fff}
img{display:block;width:100%}a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.container{width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 40px));margin:auto}

.logo{font-weight:900;font-size:24px;color:#0d1821}.logo span{color:#f26700}
